title: Jets fans give high marks to the team’s 2026 NFL Draft class

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fans give high marks to the team’s 2026 NFL Draft class
sources.description: The Jets received good NFL Draft grades from media experts. It seems like fans are also pleased with what the team is. At least that’s how it looks if you believe our SB Nation Reacts poll asking Jets fans to grade the class of 2026. You know what? I respect the fans who voted here […]
